description: This file defines a 'Spinner' UI component using LightningJS framework, which displays a rotating element and a label, typically used as a loading indicator.

classes.name: Spinner
classes.description: A LightningJS component that displays a loading spinner with a label, rotating periodically.

methods.name: primaryColor
methods.description: Computes and returns the primary color from the theme.

methods.name: textColor
methods.description: Computes and returns the text color from the theme.

methods.name: labelText
methods.description: Returns the label text if provided; otherwise, defaults to 'Loading...'.

methods.name: onMounted
methods.description: Sets up an interval timer to update the rotation angle periodically.

methods.name: onDestroyed
methods.description: Clears the interval timer when the component is destroyed.
